method: Binary classifier for neuron segment merge prediction
definition: Given 20 engineered features from adjacent EM neuron segments, predict whether they belong to the same neuron (1) or different neurons (0)

fidelity_checks.method: Class weights in LogisticRegression/RandomForest, scale_pos_weight in XGBoost, inherent in MLP with cross-entropy

fidelity_checks.required: Evaluate performance separately for each of 4 degradation types
Compare at least 3 different model architectures
fidelity_checks.method: Compared 5 models: LR, RF, GB, XGBoost, MLP
SHAP (TreeExplainer), permutation importance, built-in feature importance

fidelity_checks.required: Report AUC-ROC and Average Precision, not just accuracy
fidelity_checks.method: Primary metrics: AUC-ROC, Avg Precision; secondary: F1, Precision, Recall

deviations.reason: Task is post-segmentation classification, not segmentation. Working with pre-engineered features rather than raw EM volumes.

deviations.component: No end-to-end deep learning on images
deviations.reason: Dataset provides tabular features, not raw EM image data. MLP on features is the appropriate approach.
